name: Weave
description: Trace the hidden words on a theme. Every letter belongs to one word.
hint: Drag across letters (up, down, left, right) to trace a word · H or Hint for a letter

howTo.goal: Find the hidden words on the theme. Together they fill the grid.
rules: Words run through neighbouring letters: up, down, left or right, never diagonally.
Every letter belongs to exactly one word. The blanks show each word's length.
One puzzle a day; past days are in the archive.
